title: Turn Of A Page

[00:24.000]
[00:24.480]In the quiet of night
[00:26.920]Every shadow and light
[00:29.570]Memories overflow
[00:34.040]
[00:36.170]Where the past still lies
[00:38.500]Hidden out of sight
[00:41.750]The stars lose their glow
[00:45.990]
[00:47.920]Every time and again we see secrets unfold
[00:51.610]Every strike of a bell we hear stories retold
[00:54.920]Whispers from before
[00:55.900]Echoes come and go
[00:57.180]Gripping my soul
[00:58.330]I’ll let them go, breaking the mold
[01:00.579]
[01:01.450]The sky grows dimmer
[01:02.829]But my fire won’tturn cold
[01:04.069]From the chains and fears
[01:06.659]To dreams I uphold
[01:10.230]
[01:11.860]A turn of a page
[01:14.480]I'm leaving the cage
[01:15.900]I will step away
[01:17.420]From this empty space
[01:18.840]
[01:19.159]Every moment awake
[01:20.480]Every word I pray
[01:21.519]I'll be less afraid
[01:23.750]Of time's silent rage
[01:25.110]
[01:25.459]With the turn of a page
[01:27.000]The ink fades away
[01:28.390]A new dawn awaits
[01:29.459]A new story's made
[01:31.239]Turn of a page
[01:34.569]
[01:37.390]Every turn of a page
[01:38.720]What we can't erase
[01:39.870]What we can't unmake
[01:41.150]We’ve got to embrace
[01:43.480]
[01:43.819]Like a ghost on a stage
[01:45.200]I just feel my face
[01:46.400]Begin to fade
[01:49.760]
[01:50.120]Could this light lead me
[01:52.129]Into another place
[01:55.370]Above the fray
[01:58.890]
[02:27.509]In the silence of dawn
[02:29.360]Every string that I play
[02:32.490]Leaves a trace of what has gone
[02:37.710]Coming of a new day
[02:41.910]As the night withdraws
[02:45.289]I find my way
